name: Delivery Challan Generator
title: Delivery Challan Generator Pakistan (Free, PDF)
description: Create a delivery challan listing goods, quantity, vehicle and driver with a receiving signature box. Free, prints to PDF, nothing is uploaded.
lead: List the goods you are sending, add the vehicle and driver, and print a challan for the receiver to sign.
intro: A delivery challan travels with the goods. It lists what was sent, in what quantity, by which vehicle, and gives the receiver a place to sign. It has no prices, so it proves delivery without showing rates.
how: Add each item with quantity, unit and remarks (such as condition).
Fill in the vehicle number and driver details.
Print two copies: one stays with you, one with the receiver.
example: 20 cartons of item A and 5 drums of item B sent in vehicle LEA-1234. The receiver signs and dates the copy that comes back to you.
mistakes: Not noting damage or shortage on receipt.
No signature or date from the receiver.

faq.q: Is a delivery challan a tax invoice?
faq.a: No. It records delivery of goods. A registered person still issues a tax invoice for a taxable supply.
A challan proves the goods moved. Prices belong on the invoice.

disclaimer: This tool only lays out the details you type. It does not file anything with FBR or any authority, and it is not legal or tax advice.
